hooks.name: Update roadmap after a spec task
hooks.description: After a spec task is completed, keep the roadmap status, the spec's tasks.md and the Kiro usage log current.

action.prompt:
A spec task was just marked completed. Keep the project records current, briefly:
1. In the spec's `tasks.md`, make sure the completed task is ticked.
2. If this finished a whole roadmap task, update "Current status" in `.kiro/steering/roadmap.md` (Done / Next) and mark the task DONE in the task breakdown.
3. Append one or two lines to `docs/kiro-usage-log.md` about any Kiro feature that mattered for this task (spec, hook, steering, agent, sub-agent, MCP, power, property-based test) and what it changed.
4. If a new gotcha or research finding came up, add it to `dev-environment.md` or `research-and-licenses.md`.
5. If you added, renamed or removed anything in `.kiro`, update `.kiro/README.md` and the layout in `kiro-workflow.md`.
Do not invent progress: only record what actually happened in this session. Never write secrets or the AWS account ID.
